summary: The bad() entry point reaches an assertion `assert "".length() > 0;` on a value that fails the condition, so running with assertions enabled always throws an AssertionError (CWE-617 Reachable Assertion). The fix replaces the unguarded assertion with a normal runtime length check that handles both the non-empty and empty cases gracefully, preserving the length-inspection behavior without crashing on valid input.
